definitions.gloss: milt; fish sperm sac; soft roe
definitions.explanation: The sperm sac of male fish, considered a delicacy in Japanese cuisine. Most commonly from cod (tara) or pufferfish (fugu), it has a soft, creamy texture and mild flavor.

examples.japanese: {白子|しらこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポン{酢|ず}→ポン酢：11115_ponzu⟧{和|あ}え。
⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鱈|たら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白子|しらこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Winter is the season when cod milt is delicious.

examples.japanese: {白子|しらこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{敬遠|けいえん}→敬遠：12930_keien⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧みる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧クリーミーで⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧な⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some people are put off by the appearance of milt, but when you try it, it has a creamy, rich flavor.

notes:
Written with the characters {白|しら} (white) and ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child/offspring), referring to the white, soft appearance of the sac. A seasonal winter delicacy, especially prized from {鱈|たら} (cod) and {河豚|ふぐ} (pufferfish). It is the male counterpart to ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧/⟦{魚卵|ぎょらん}→魚卵：15386_gyoran⟧ (fish eggs/roe).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鱈|たら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白子|しらこ}: cod milt
- {河豚|ふぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白子|しらこ}: pufferfish milt
- {白子|しらこ}⟦ポン{酢|ず}→ポン酢：11115_ponzu⟧: milt with ponzu
- {白子|しらこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: deep-fried milt
- {白子|しらこ}⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: milt hot pot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卵巣|らんそう}/{真子|まこ}: roe, ovary — the female counterpart; fish eggs
- ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧: herring roe — a specific type of fish roe eaten at New Year
- ⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧: cod roe — salted cod eggs, a common food item

USAGE:
The word {白子|しらこ} can also refer to a person or animal with albinism, though this usage is less common in modern Japanese.
